skills.name: nextjs-routing
skills.description: Builds Next.js App Router routes — server vs client components with the "use client" boundary pushed down, layouts, loading and error boundaries, route handlers, metadata, dynamic params and caching/revalidation choices. Use when asked to "add a page", "add a route", "add an API route", "why is this page not updating", "fix hydration error", or when editing page.tsx, layout.tsx or route.ts.

skills.name: nextjs-server-action
skills.description: Writes Next.js server actions with schema-validated input, auth and tenant checks inside the action, a typed discriminated result, revalidatePath/revalidateTag, and data access delegated to a service module. Use when asked to "add a server action", "handle this form submit on the server", "add a mutation", or when creating a file with "use server".
